################################################################################
# na8ve-os ESP32-S3 Sandboxed Application Board Definitions (na8ve:esp32s3)
################################################################################

menu.grants=na8ve-os Capability Grants
menu.target_slot=Target Deployment Slot

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense (na8ve-os)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.name=Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense (na8ve-os)

# Native USB CDC-ACM Auto-Discovery (Espressif USB_DEVICE 0x303A:0x1001)
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.vid.0=0x303A
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.pid.0=0x1001
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.upload_port.0.vid=0x303A
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.upload_port.0.pid=0x1001

# Serial Monitor: never toggle RTS into ROM bootloader mode; talk to na8ve-os console
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.serial.disableDTR=false
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.serial.disableRTS=true

# Build & Memory Ceilings (64 KB linear memory, 8 KB stack, 64,512 B payload)
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.build.board=XIAO_ESP32S3_NA8VE_PVM
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.build.core=na8ve_pvm
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.build.variant=xiao_esp32s3_sense
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.build.mcu=wasm32
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.build.f_cpu=240000000L
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.build.linear_max=65536
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.build.stack_size=8192
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.build.budget_ms=2000

# Upload Ceilings (64,512 B signed app payload limit, 65,536 B arena)
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.upload.tool=na8ve_upload
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.upload.tool.default=na8ve_upload
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.upload.tool.serial=na8ve_upload
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.upload.protocol=esptool
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.upload.speed=115200
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.upload.maximum_size=64512
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.upload.maximum_data_size=65536

# Menu 1: Declared Capability Grants
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.grants.broker_store_act=Model Broker + Store Read + Actuator Policy (ipc:1, store:r, act)
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.grants.broker_store_act.build.grants_flags=--grant-ipc=1 --grant-store=query:r --grant-act --grant-seam
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.grants.broker_only=Model Broker Only (ipc:1)
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.grants.broker_only.build.grants_flags=--grant-ipc=1
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.grants.store_only=Store Read Only (store:r)
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.grants.store_only.build.grants_flags=--grant-store=query:r
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.grants.pure_compute=Pure Compute Sandbox (No Grants)
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.grants.pure_compute.build.grants_flags=

# Menu 2: Target Deployment Slot
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.target_slot.pvm1_flash=On-Chip App Slot (Standard)
xiao_esp32s3_na8ve.menu.target_slot.pvm1_flash.upload.slot_flag=--slot=pvm_1

# Menu 3: Release Optimization
